metadata.description: The shell service's conformance rows (H01-H07), extending the sandbox's provider rows: the real service over the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, negatives judged by bytes outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Cacheable only under the shell environment fingerprint (scripts/src/shell-evidence.ts, CF-1): the hash covers the source closure and the row's OS, kernel, Bash, runner image, sandbox runtime and node-pty, and is a fresh nonce unless the run asked for reuse, so candidate, drift and promotion runs never hit. A hit restores the receipt that first proved the verdict and its verdict record; the workflow's uncached stamp step says so.
